relationships.subject: CFA lumbar muscle inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: KCC2 expression is not modulated by step-training or CFA injection in this model

key_findings: After complete spinal transection in mice, lumbar muscle CFA inflammation impairs hindlimb kinematics and increases Iba1+ microglia in dorsal and ventral horns; step-training partly improves kinematics.
Neither CFA nor step-training altered KCC2 expression in dorsal horn or motoneuron membranes, so inflammation-induced locomotor deficits are KCC2-independent.
